doc.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Travelling by car and the firefly headlights
summary: Poor cars on the road, including a car with no lights fitted with bottled fireflies.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Most times we’re traveling by cars. Some very funny experiences. Once we were traveling. The cars were in pretty bad shape most times. One car we had, the lights went out on the car. So we didn’t have any lights in the front. So we caught a lot of those fireflies and put them in bottles, big bottles, and put that on the front of the car, so that people coming – it wasn’t a lot of people on the highway, but that was one of the funny things that happened.
No, no, no. That’s it. That was it.
What’d you have, like a thousand fireflies in each bottle or something?
There were a lot of fireflies.
Has that ever made that way into your – is there a firefly suite somewhere that I haven’t heard?
No. There should have been. It’s true.
